entities.name: Jalira
entities.description: A human wizard and polymorphist from Shandalar, known as a swindler and con artist in Lesh.

entities.name: Yisan
entities.description: Jalira's travel companion and fellow ne'er-do-well, who stayed in the Skep to study slivers.

entities.name: Hastric
entities.description: Rambling Thunian whose journal described the route to the Skep.

entities.name: Dexros
entities.description: Commander of the guard in Lesh.

entities.name: Sliver Hivelord
entities.description: Sliver leader who stripped Jalira and Yisan of sliver bodies.

entities.name: Skep
entities.description: Place of sliver caves with corpses and riches.

events.summary: Jalira and Yisan steal from Hastric but are caught by Dexros; Yisan keeps Hastric's journal.
events.quote: Yisan kept Hastric's journal, which described the route to the Skep.

events.summary: They travel to the Skep seeking riches from corpses.
events.quote: Knowing there would be riches on the corpses of those who had died in the Skep

events.summary: Jalira and Yisan are transformed into slivers, then restored by a Sliver Hivelord.
events.quote: they found themselves transformed into slivers

events.summary: Jalira leaves with loot for Martyne while Yisan stays to study slivers.

relations.quote: Alongside her travel companion and fellow ne'er-do-well Yisan
